player_prompt.intro:
I chhungkua Player {player_id} i ni. 15-Puzzle game i khelh mek a ni.
He game khelh dan ber chu, number tile te chu 1 atanga 15 thleng, chunglam atanga zauh lamah, ascending order-a rem tur a ni. Empty space chu a tawp berna, bottom-right corner-ah a awm tur a ni.
Move tum turin, double underscore(__) in empty space a tarlan, a hnuai, chung, vei lam leh zauh lam atanga tile chu insawn theih a ni. Heng command te hman tur a ni:
- 'up': Empty space chung a tile sawn chung lamah.
- 'down': Empty space hnuai a tile sawn hnuai lamah.
- 'left': Empty space vei lam a tile sawn vei lamah.
- 'right': Empty space zauh lam a tile sawn zauh lamah.
Move thehluh turin, direction (entirnan, 'up', 'down', 'left', emaw 'right') square bracket-ah chuang tur a ni, entirnan, [up].
Tun dinhmun board layout chu a hnuai ah hian tarlan a ni. He information hmang hian puzzle chinfel tur a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move format dik lo. Player {player_id} chuan direction dik square bracket-ah a pe lo.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Hnawhchhuah diklo. Tile hi a hmingah tihkhawt theih a ni lo va.

outcome.win: Lawmthu sawi ang che! Player {player_id} chuan 15-Puzzle chu a solve hlawhtling ta.
outcome.turn_limit: A turn chin chu a thleng ta. Model chuan puzzle percent {percent} khat zet a ti zo tawh
